label: Existence is presence now, and something was present at another time but is not present now
paraphrase: Rival framework commitment, unattributed: an individual exists in a history exactly when it is present at that history's designated now, and some individual is present at a time of a history without being present at its now. Replacement account: presentism about existence, on which what was present earlier and is no longer present does not exist. Stronger than the negation of presence-to-existence.
